sentiment.rationale: The company reported a strong quarter with revenue growth of 32% year-over-year, accelerating from 29% last quarter, and provided guidance for Q2 and full year 2026 that implies continued strong growth (Q2 revenue growth of 29-31% YoY, full year 25-27% YoY). Management expressed high confidence, citing record ARR additions, record new logo bookings, and broad-based strength. Although the guidance was not explicitly raised relative to prior guidance (no prior guidance is provided in the document), the strong momentum and confident language support a positive score. The score is below +0.7 because the guidance was not explicitly raised versus a prior stated figure, and there are some risks mentioned (e.g., macro uncertainties, competition).
